summary: Iteration 4: verified reported UX fixes end-to-end. All 6 fixes VERIFIED WORKING: (a) Telegram status cache — cold ~0.30s, warm <0.05s. (b) Nav flex-wrap — all 8 tabs visible in one row (['keys','usage','jobs','health','logs','commands','settings','client-keys']), no horizontal scroll. (c) Tab persistence — clicking CLIENT KEYS writes localStorage.router_active_tab='client-keys'; page reload keeps dashboard-header + create-client-key-button visible (does NOT drop to login or reset to API KEYS). (d) Graceful 401 — invalid JWT triggers return to login screen (no infinite reload). (e) Live auto-poll — after firing POST /api/v1/chat/completions the JOBS panel grew from 3->4 rows and header 'Reqs Today' went 2->3 within ~7s without manual refresh. (f) Router regression — chat.completions returns valid OpenAI-style body {object:'chat.completion', content:'OK'}. Client key create → one-time reveal (client-key-reveal) works; revoke works. HOWEVER: one CRITICAL bug remains — the documented router client key 'sk-router-Y7as_5RakGo-uoD6_VyGVF04AU-OG4Ut' (in /app/memory/test_credentials.md and backend/.env DEMO_CLIENT_KEY) does NOT match the DB-stored 'Default Client (Cline)' hash (DB prefix is 'sk-router-FMGd…'). Router requests with the documented key return 401. Backend /api/v1/chat/completions with Bearer sk-router-Y7as... → HTTP 401 'Invalid or revoked router API key'. This means any real Cline user still configured with that documented key is broken and it directly reproduces the user's complaint that the 'client keys section is confusing'.

critical.issue: Documented router key sk-router-Y7as_5RakGo-uoD6_VyGVF04AU-OG4Ut (env DEMO_CLIENT_KEY + test_credentials.md) does not match seeded 'Default Client (Cline)' hash in DB (actual prefix sk-router-FMGd…). Seeder in server.py:_seed() only runs when client_keys count==0, so after the reset the collection was populated with a randomly generated plaintext instead of DEMO_CLIENT_KEY. Any agent/Cline using the documented key gets 401.

Also a leftover user-created key named 'sad' (prefix sk-router-90wV) is still active in the DB; not created by tester, so left alone per instructions.

rca of the issue: Root cause of remaining critical bug: server.py:_seed() creates 'Default Client (Cline)' only when the collection is empty, passing plaintext=DEMO_CLIENT_KEY. When the collection was 'reset to a single active Default Client (Cline)' as claimed in the review, the reset apparently ran through create_client_key WITHOUT passing plaintext (so a random secrets.token_urlsafe(24) was generated). Now count>0, so the startup seeder skips, and the DB permanently holds a random-plaintext row whose hash doesn't match the documented Bearer. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $BE/api/v1/chat/completions -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-router-Y7as_5RakGo-uoD6_VyGVF04AU-OG4Ut' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"gpt-5.4","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'` → 401. Mitigation: change _seed() to upsert the Default Client (Cline) by name so its key_hash is always hash_client_key(DEMO_CLIENT_KEY); or delete the current row and let _seed() recreate it correctly on next boot.
